description:
Cross-platform desktop application for translation based on ChatGPT API.


The end of translations no longer goes missing with OpenRouter and some other providers
- With some providers, notably Gemini via OpenRouter, the last sentence or paragraph of a translation could be cut off. It is now always shown (#1810, #1923, thanks @Hyhyhyyy)
- Cerebras now shares the common OpenAI-compatible streaming code, so it gets the same fix (#1923)
